# Original Farmyard door presentation evidence

Source: https://github.com/Syntaxswine/farmyard-commando at 251bf8094b5f9ebe44208443084c1a6d6658512a. The original interaction-view.js and wood-factory-v2.png byte streams remain unchanged. Embedded comments and attribution remain in their original files. The pinned project has no blanket licence; this intake adds no licence grant.

Only the timber texture is a runtime resource. The mixed chest/door/clue view and its game/Three closure are reference-only; they are never imported by the provider. The separately maintained Nautilus provider reuses the existing AFT-pinned Three.js and its retained MIT notice. provenance.json records the source/static dependency hashes, deferred chest/clue resources, and original provenance/notice references without duplicating that runtime.
